description: Command payload: declare a substrate upgrade (old digest → new digest, recertification required). The upgrade never rebinds a Possession — a new possession version must be created explicitly. Travels inside an Envelope with a REQUIRED non-null idempotency key (lock rule 17). Payload schema only — the envelope wire shape is arena:schema/protocol/envelope@1.0.
title: Arena declare-substrate-upgrade-command v1
